entries.what: Woke at 5 a.m. to Hana's feed, then Brenda's first Monday check-in email landed at 8:15 about his return date. He read it twice with Theo on his chest.
entries.outcome: Left it unanswered and vented to the assistant that Brenda is a clipboard with a pulse.

entries.what: Logged the morning naps in the spreadsheet while Theo contact-napped on him in the apartment.
entries.outcome: Got two full naps tracked and ate cold toast.

entries.what: Evening witching hour of crying, then takeout dinner with Hana.
entries.outcome: Theo settled around 8 to the ballpark organ hum.

entries.what: Stroller errand to pick up diapers and wipes, then a quick rinse of bottles.
entries.outcome: Home before the afternoon nap.

entries.what: Baby laundry in the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room Tuesday night.
entries.outcome: Two loads done, folded while Hana watched Theo.

entries.what: Took the 2 a.m. feed and logged it in the spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Theo went back down after 40 minutes.

entries.what: Hana had a rough morning and stayed quiet over breakfast; Elliot took Theo for the day without asking questions.
entries.outcome: She went to an appointment in the afternoon; he let her go without comment.

entries.what: Put together a puzzle section on the card table during Theo's nap.
entries.outcome: Placed eleven lighthouse pieces.

entries.what: Ordered diapers by delivery and made boxed pasta for dinner.
entries.outcome: Ate together before the evening fuss.

entries.what: Took Theo to Thursday 10:30 baby story time at the library with Kaitlyn and the other parents.
entries.outcome: Theo stayed alert and smiley the whole session.

entries.what: Walked back past Heron-side shops and picked up a pour-over filter he never used.
entries.outcome: Pour-over gear stayed on the fridge.

entries.what: Evening crying stretch; Elliot hummed and bounced Theo for an hour.
entries.outcome: Theo slept in the bassinet until 2.

entries.what: Compiled nine days of nap times in the spreadsheet and pasted them to the assistant asking for a regression analysis of wake windows.
entries.outcome: Got a rough wake-window estimate to test next week.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry run at Marisol Gardens.
entries.outcome: Done by 9.

entries.what: Phở Bến Thành takeout with Hana after Theo went down.
entries.outcome: Rare beef pho, no tripe, and a quiet evening.

entries.what: Saturday market run to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier.
entries.outcome: Bought produce and oat milk and avoided delivery.

entries.what: Heard from a neighbor that the Ridgeline hiring fair drew long lines on Ruel Road, snarling the drive home.
entries.outcome: Took the back way along Vinca.

entries.what: Judith visited, held Theo, and said the crib would be a good idea.
entries.outcome: Decided to move Theo to the crib Sunday.

entries.what: Assembled the nursery corner in the spare room and set the white-noise machine to rain.
entries.outcome: Crib ready by noon.

entries.what: Moved Theo from the bassinet to the crib for the afternoon nap and watched the monitor.
entries.outcome: He slept 80 minutes, the monitor dropping once when the microwave ran.

entries.what: Scored the first night in the crib like a baseball game and logged it.
entries.outcome: Two wake-ups but both settled.
